Transport & itineraries · Ellora Cave 16

Railway Station to Kailasa Temple

Rail travel gets you to the regional gateway; the final leg to the Ellora Caves at Verul is by road and needs its own arrangement.

Google Maps ↗ ASI source listing ↗

Independent guide · Page reviewed 9 November 2026 · ASI listing consulted 2026-10-29

Kailasa Temple (Cave 16) is one monument within the UNESCO-listed Ellora Caves. Prices, opening status and routes are dated listings to re-check, not live confirmations.

  1. Kailasa Temple Verul
  2. Transport & itineraries
  3. Railway Station to Kailasa Temple

Get the station name right

The city is referred to both as Aurangabad and Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, and station names in booking systems may follow either usage. Confirm the exact station name and its distance from your intended accommodation before buying a ticket.

The Ellora Caves are near Verul, not inside the city. ASI places the complex roughly 30 km north-northwest of the city it calls Aurangabad.

Arranging the onward leg

Plan the station-to-Ellora transfer, the return and the waiting arrangement before arrival. This guide does not publish train numbers, timetables, bus routes or taxi fares because they have not been independently verified.

Check whether your arrival time fits the ASI sunrise-to-sunset visiting window and the weekly Tuesday closure before committing to a same-day visit.

  • Confirm the current station name in your booking.
  • Agree the vehicle, waiting time and return plan in advance.
  • Fix the actual gate as the meeting point, not a UNESCO property coordinate.
  • Keep admission and internal walking time in the schedule.

If you arrive late

Staying in the city and starting early the next morning is often simpler than a rushed late-day visit. See the where-to-stay and half-day itinerary pages for a calmer plan.

Reviewed 9 November 2026. No train or bus data is claimed as verified.

Frequently asked questions

Is there a railway station at Ellora?

This guide has not verified a station at the caves. The usual approach is rail to the regional city and then a road transfer; confirm current services locally.

Which station should I book to?

Check whether your booking system uses Aurangabad or Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar for the same city, and confirm the name before purchase.

Are there buses from the station to Ellora?

Current bus services are not verified here. Check locally or see the travel services page.
